'''2008 Worlds Day 1 David McCune DS Let Them Make The First Move''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[David McCune]] at [[2008 World Championship]] (Day 1). Sheet title Loses to wts.


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[David McCune]]
* '''Event:''' [[2008 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS16]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Let Them Make The First Move / At Peace|Let Them Make The First Move]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
